scope: Visible rendered body text of the eighteen reciprocal primary routes assigned to AM357-N01 through AM357-N09, deduplicating faithful Spanish and English equivalents and stopping at the first hop.
scope_rule: Do not follow deeper links. Count every distinct named identity-eligible person, organisation or controlled perimeter, institution or separately named sub-organ, and formal proceeding appearing in the eighteen route bodies. A shorthand remains pending when it cannot safely inherit an admitted identity. A perimeter caret confirms only that perimeter, never an exact legal person, contracting role, act or liability.
inclusion_rules: Use rendered body text only; head metadata, navigation, footers and href-only targets do not create eligible objects.
Deduplicate a faithful Spanish and English rendering of the same object into one census record.

Retain InteriHOTEL Canarias as a named publisher/event perimeter, CGPJ Permanent Commission and CGPJ Inspection as separately named sub-organs, and Policía Judicial as a named institutional function; these four conservative inclusions fix the denominator at 130.
Treat a separately named legal person, commercial or professional perimeter, institution sub-organ, and proceeding as its own object unless an exact admitted alias establishes identity.
Count a current CAEPR structure or perimeter record as confirmed only when the displayed object is expressly the same structure or perimeter; no exact-legal-person inference follows.
exclusion_rules: Exclude deeper linked-route bodies and objects appearing only in a URL, slug or link target.
Exclude source quotations and names appearing only inside quoted source text.
Exclude filenames, document and order titles, evidence exhibits, statutes and provisions, dates, amounts and citation identifiers.
Exclude asset, project, platform, publication-control and event labels unless the route body separately presents the label as an organisation or controlled perimeter.
Exclude generic roles such as judge, insolvency administrator, creditor, bidder, witness, police officer or prosecutor unless a distinct institution, sub-organ, person or proceeding is named.

core_32_overlap.rule: The six-surface audit is now closed at 31/31 unique identities and 32/32 occurrence rows. This overlap counts only the 31 core objects visible in the first-hop route bodies; its one residual role/label distinction must not be relabelled as an unresolved principal-scope identity.

unitary_scope_reference.rule: The repository-wide 21/24 unitary census is separate and remains partial with three explicit exceptions; it is neither replaced nor closed by this first-hop control.

verdict: FULL FIRST-HOP CENSUS COMPLETE; 61/130 CARET_CONFIRMED; 69 CARET_PENDING; 0 CARET_SUSPENDED; PARTIAL — NOT ALL IS^
invariants: A caret confirms identity reconciliation only.

A caret does not prove conduct, date-specific capacity, signature, allocation, substitution, knowledge, intent, relationship, conflict, concealment, causation, harm, benefit, liability, source authenticity or outcome.
A confirmed perimeter never transfers its caret to an exact legal person or proves that the perimeter contracted, controlled, paid, received, knew or benefited.
A pending object receives no caret.
Every route occurrence must independently match the admitted canonical name or alias; object-level confirmation does not cure an unresolved shorthand occurrence.
No ALL IS^ claim is permitted while any of the 130 objects remains pending or suspended.
collision_guards: ACTÚA valuation perimeter is not Actyus PD-SP-O-0060.
Owners’ Community PD-SP-O-0005 is not CEXP PD-SP-O-0006, and bare Community resolves to neither without context.
The wider ONA commercial perimeter is not Clubotel La Dorada, S.L.; PD-SP-O-0075 resolves only the exact ONA-side legal person for the 6 June 2018 funded-exit operating instrument.

CGPJ parent identity does not transfer conduct to its Permanent Commission or Inspection.
General Fiscalía PD-SP-I-0002 is distinct from Fiscalía Provincial de Las Palmas PD-SP-I-0020 and its Registro General PD-SP-I-0021; none identifies a prosecutor or specialist section.
Carlos Sanz is not Carlos Llamas Sanz PD-SP-P-0062, and bare Carlos does not identify Carlos Saavedra PD-SP-P-0036.

rendered_occurrence_control.rendered_scope: The normalized visible text inside each <main> element only. Head metadata, header navigation, footers, scripts, styles, templates, noscript, hidden and aria-hidden content are excluded.
rendered_occurrence_control.human_audit_assertion: Every identity-eligible rendered occurrence in the frozen eighteen-surface first-hop corpus is assigned to exactly one of the 130 deduplicated object keys and therefore inherits that record's CARET_CONFIRMED or CARET_PENDING state. Repetitions and faithful ES/EN translations are not new objects.
rendered_occurrence_control.machine_attestation_limit: The validator proves the exact eighteen normalized <main> snapshots and one exact rendered body anchor for every deduplicated object. It does not pretend that automated string matching can replace the human semantic decision about entity eligibility, aliases, quotations or perimeter boundaries.
rendered_occurrence_control.inline_rendering_policy: NO_INLINE_CARETS_ON_FIRST_HOP_SOURCE_ROUTES. This census records identity state; it does not add a caret to a shorthand, source literal or any route occurrence.
